profile.headline: Full-stack software engineer specializing in building web applications, designing and deploying Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions with LLM, AWS Bedrock, vector databases, scaling and optimizations.
profile.summary: I'm a sociable and flexible professional. I can fit in any environments very easily and always have an urge to learn new things. Making life easier to live using technologies is always the source of inspiration for me. And most importantly, i take responsibility seriously.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Built and deployed a RAG system for existing enterprise knowledge hubs (~100K documents) using open-source embedding models, Qdrant, and LLMs
- Automated data ingestion and embedding pipelines for 3rd party knowledge hubs such as Salesforce, utilizing AWS Bedrock and other AWS connectors
- Optimized embedding and retrieval by reducing Qdrant upsert latency, migrating to multimodal embedding models, and evaluating quality with RAGAS
- Automated engineering workflows such as ticket triage, code reviews and bug investigation using Claude Code with custom AI skills and agents
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLM) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · C# · Python · PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Vector Databases · qdrant

projects.title: Vaporbeast
projects.description:
Using Magento, i achieved the following main goals:
- Implemented a new theme for mobile devices
- Refactored and improved legacy codes using Magento’s standards and best practice
- Utilized Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager to improve reports
- Integrated New Relics using custom data to monitor and resolve server issues
- Optimized the application’s performance to handle more requests
- Identified and resolved critical issues that affect sales performance

projects.title: Pomelo Fashion
projects.description: Pomelo fashion is an online shop that has many complicated features, aiming at pleasing and making it easy for female shoppers to decide on their purchases quickly, as well as keeping visitors coming back. I am responsible for many of the tasks contributing to the company growth, working in both backend and frontend of the website along with other members of the engineer team.
